quotations.old_english: Ne mót man iungum men wíf forgyfan, gif hé hine ǽr tó munucháde (monachismo) gemynte
Oft on lǽwedum háde and on lǽwedum girelan mid gódum weorcum and mid ryhte lífe man oferðíhð ðone munuchád and ðá óðre ðe ðone hiérran hád habbað
quotations.latin: quidam in deteriori ordine sortem extremi habitus bene vivendo transcendunt

quotations.old_english: Heó wæs gelǽded tó ðám munucháde þe heó wilnode and gyrnde
quotations.latin: ad eum quem desiderabat habitum perducta est

quotations.old_english: Sum eald wíf in hálgum munucháde in þissere byrig wunode
quotations.latin: anus quaedam in sanctimoniali habitu constituta in hac urbe manebat

source_text: munuc-hád. Add: I. general or of a man :-- In munucháde in monachico habitu, Gr. D. 27, 18. Ne mót man iungum men wíf forgyfan, gif hé hine ǽr tó munucháde (monachismo) gemynte, Ll. Th. ii. 142, 9. Oft on lǽwedum háde and on lǽwedum girelan mid gódum weorcum and mid ryhte lífe man oferðíhð ðone munuchád and ðá óðre ðe ðone hiérran hád habbað quidam in deteriori ordine sortem extremi habitus bene vivendo transcendunt, Past. 411. 36. II. of a woman :-- Heó wæs gelǽded tó ðám munucháde þe heó wilnode and gyrnde ad eum quem desiderabat habitum perducta est, Gr. D. 199, 19. Sum eald wíf in hálgum munucháde in þissere byrig wunode anus quaedam in sanctimoniali habitu constituta in hac urbe manebat, 283, 5.
